RSS Chief Mohan Bhagwat Addresses Youth Concerns on Protesting and Reservation

RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat stated that protesting does not make youth anti-national and that their grievances are genuine and should be addressed. He also commented on reservation, saying it is for upliftment and not permanent, and that the quota system has been deliberately politicized. Bhagwat interacted with Gen Z students, using their slang and praising their honesty, and also touched upon the education budget and environmental development.
